tasks.short: Coordinate clearances and switching information with utility workers.

steps.what: Coordinate with engineers, planners, field personnel, or other utility workers.
To provide information such as clearances, switching orders, or distribution process changes.

tasks.design: The dispatcher phones engineers, planners, and field personnel on {TELEPHONY} and states the clearance, the switching order, or the distribution process change in that call. The talk is the work. No second entry of that clearance is added, and no model issues a switching order.
tasks.previous_blocker: A wrong clearance puts a crew on live equipment. The right section and the right moment are known only in the call.
tasks.enabler_now: The group digest keeps switching and control with operators. This task is that coordination. It is not a log re-key and it is not a load forecast.
tasks.still_hard: Naming the wrong clearance, or a process change the field crew has not heard, leaves people on a live section.
tasks.human_edge: Matching the clearance to the crew and the section that are actually in the field.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The dispatcher still makes the call and still states the clearance, the order, or the process change.

reach.task: Confirm a clearance before work starts on a live section
reach.learn: Which clearance and which section the dispatcher named.

evidence.claim: Coordinating clearances and switching information with utility workers stays with the dispatcher. Switching and control stay with operators.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the dispatch desk coordinates with utility workers by phone. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If the call cannot be placed, the dispatcher still phones them. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether some clearances are also written after the call. That writing is not in this statement.
research_questions: Does this dispatcher write the clearance into a second record after the call, or only say it?

already_counted.description: The call and the clearance stated in it both remain.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. The call and the clearance stated in it are the work, and no second entry is documented for this statement, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct operators, including when to start boilers or generators.

steps.what: Direct personnel engaged in controlling or operating distribution equipment or machinery.
Do this by instructing control room operators to start boilers or generators.

tasks.design: The dispatcher directs the people who run the distribution equipment, and on {TELEPHONY} instructs control room operators to start boilers or generators. The operator still starts the machine. The instruction is spoken in that direction and is not entered again as a separate message.
tasks.previous_blocker: A wrong start moves steam or generation the network is not ready for. The dispatcher has to see the board and the people who run it.
tasks.enabler_now: The group digest keeps control actions with operators. Instructing a start is that control. A model does not start the boiler or the generator.
tasks.still_hard: Telling the operator to start the wrong unit, or at the wrong moment, trips load or equipment.
tasks.human_edge: Judging which unit to start and whether the operator in the room can start it now.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The dispatcher still directs the personnel and still instructs the start. The operator still starts the machine.

reach.task: Start a boiler when the dispatcher instructs it
reach.learn: The start remains the operator's act after the instruction.

evidence.claim: Directing distribution personnel, including an instruction to start a boiler or a generator, stays with the dispatcher. The operator still performs the start.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the dispatch desk directs control room operators by phone. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If the call cannot be placed, the dispatcher still phones them. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether a start instruction is also written after it is spoken. This statement only shows the spoken direction.
research_questions: Does this dispatcher enter the start instruction in a second record after saying it, or only say it?

already_counted.description: The direction and the start instruction both remain.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. Directing the personnel and instructing the start are the work, and no second entry is documented for this statement, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.short: Prepare switching orders from power-system drawings.

steps.what: Prepare switching orders to isolate areas without causing power outages, referring to drawings of systems.

tasks.design: The dispatcher reads the drawings in {DOCS} and writes the switching order that isolates the work area without an outage. That order is the judgement. It is not handed to a model, and preparing it is not a second typing of the drawing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The isolation points sit on the drawing of this network. A wrong point drops load or leaves the area live.
tasks.enabler_now: The group digest keeps switching with operators. Preparing the isolation order is that judgement. Referring to the drawings is the reading that already happens. No second key-in of the drawing is added.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing points that isolate the area and still keep the rest of the network supplied.
tasks.human_edge: Reading this network's drawing and choosing an isolation that does not drop load.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The dispatcher still reads the drawings and still prepares the switching order.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
reach.task: Hold work until the switching order isolates the area

evidence.claim: Preparing a switching order from power-system drawings, so a work area is isolated without an outage, stays with the dispatcher.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is preparing the switching order from the drawings. No structured feed of the drawing is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If the drawing is not on screen, the dispatcher still reads the paper drawing. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now. Existing drawing runtime is not human effort.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether the prepared order is later issued on a separate channel. This statement stops at preparing it.
research_questions: Does this dispatcher type the drawing into a second system while preparing the order, or only read the drawing and write the order?

already_counted.description: Preparing the switching order remains in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. Reading the drawings and preparing the isolation order are the work, and no second entry is documented for this statement, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.short: Monitor and record control board readings.

steps.what: Monitor switchboard or control board readings to ensure electrical or steam distribution equipment operating properly.
Also record those switchboard or control board readings.

tasks.design: The dispatcher watches the switchboard or control board on {OPS_SYSTEM} and notes the readings on that same board while judging whether electrical or steam distribution equipment is operating properly. The note is part of the watch. It is not a second typing into another record. Compiling gauge readings on other tasks in this group is a different statement, and the machines class is not a reason to invent a second record here.
tasks.previous_blocker: An off-normal reading is visible only on this board, in this moment, against how this network usually runs.
tasks.enabler_now: Historian re-key and rounds apps in the group digest cover other record and compile tasks, and field rounds, in this minor group. They do not cover this dispatcher's board watch. The machines class is not a reason to invent a second record. Watching the board to judge proper operation stays with the dispatcher.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing which reading means the equipment is not operating properly, among many normal movements.
tasks.human_edge: Judging an off-normal reading on this board while the dispatcher is the one watching it.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The dispatcher still watches the board and still notes the readings.

reach.task: Read the same board when the dispatcher flags an off-normal reading
reach.learn: Which reading is treated as not operating properly.

evidence.claim: Watching switchboard or control board readings and noting them on the same board stays with the dispatcher. Compiling gauge readings and field rounds are other tasks in this minor group.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is the board watch and the note of those readings on the same board. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. Existing board runtime is not human effort. If the board is down, the dispatcher still watches the instruments in person. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this dispatcher writes board readings into a second record after the watch. This statement only shows the watch and the note of the readings.
research_questions: Does this dispatcher type the same readings into a second operations record, or only note them on the board being watched?

already_counted.description: The watch and the note of the readings both remain.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No time leaves this task. Watching the board and noting the readings on it are the work, and no second entry is documented for this statement, so the low stays at zero.
